title: [GMCP 203.014.M] Mastery: Official Tasks extension and durable long-running work
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-014-M. Pass the complete vector mastery target on the shipped production path: The official Tasks extension is implemented on both client and server for get, update, cancel, notifications, state transitions, expiry, retries, ownership and server-directed execution. Durable tasks survive process restart exactly once, compose with MRTR and progress, enforce terminal-state invariants, and reject stale, cross-user, forged or replayed task handles. Consume and verify the evidence produced by requirements 01-06; reject missing, stale, unsigned, locally modified, waived, mock-only, or zero-test evidence. Task closure and roadmap prose are not proof.
limitations: Linux/Unix domain socket transport checks in `gmcp_req_203_014_03_integration` through `gmcp_vc_203_014_mastery` are compiled under `#[cfg(unix)]`, while Windows x86_64 executes full in-process `GmcpService`/`TaskManager::open`, embedded adapter, `susi mcp serve` stdio, and Streamable HTTP `/mcp` + Wire SDK `Session` parity.

Non-resumable in-flight tasks interrupted by ungraceful server termination reconcile deterministically once to `failed` (`-32603`) on process restart while settled terminal payloads replay within `ttlMs` without re-executing side effects; multi-node distributed task replication remains out of scope.

Phase 1 keeps T-CODEXGMCPROADMAP-106 open until shipped to `origin/main` with two-phase `record-gmcp` + `record-gmcp --mastery` evidence bound in `.agents/gmcp/evidence/VC-203-014.jsonl`; Phase 2 executes formal task closure.

reuse.why: Reused shipped `TaskManager`, `GmcpService`, `GmcpServer`, `StdioGate`, `susi_wire_client::mcp::{Session, PersistedTaskHandleStore}`, `susi_gmcp::requirements_ledger`, and `susi mcp` CLI/tool surfaces (closing the pre-cancelled `TaskContext::request_input` race in `task_manager.rs` at zero net lines) to prove end-to-end VC-203-014 mastery and commit-bound evidence verification.
